newsitem.title: CHINA: China Everbright Bank plans listing in 3-5 years.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright Bank plans listing in 3-5 years.

text.p: China's Everbright Bank is hoping to list on the Shanghai or Hong Kong stock exchanges within three to five years, the Financial News said on Wednesday, quoting company officials.
The bank's controlling parent China Everbright (Group) Corp would reduce its stake to below 50 percent by the end of the century, the newspaper quoted bank President Zhu Xiaohua as saying.
Everbright Bank hoped to boost its net assets to 6.0-8.0 billion yuan ($723-$964 million) and to set up 10-15 branches and 20-25 sub-branches by 2000, Zhu said.
Everbright, China's first joint stock bank, has 132 shareholders owning shares worth 2.8 billion yuan. China Everbright (Group) Corp holds 51 percent of the shares.
The bank recorded profits of 891 million yuan in 1996 and its assets totalled 52.9 billion yuan at the end of last year, earlier reports said.
